GuideReferralCode.title: How to Use a Crypto Referral Code
GuideReferralCode.subtitle: A short, practical guide to entering referral codes correctly and avoiding common mistakes.
GuideReferralCode.step1: Open the official sign-up page (preferably using the referral link).
GuideReferralCode.step2: Find the optional “Referral / Invitation / Promo” field.
GuideReferralCode.step3: Paste the code and submit registration.
GuideReferralCode.step4: After registration, complete KYC if required for rewards.
GuideReferralCode.step5: Check the exchange rewards/bonus center for tasks and deadlines.
GuideReferralCode.mistake1: Registering first and trying to add the code later.
GuideReferralCode.mistake2: Using a code meant for another exchange or region.
GuideReferralCode.mistake3: Ignoring deposit/trading requirements and reward expiration.
GuideReferralCode.mistake4: Not checking the official terms for the current campaign.
